name: Nellee Hooper
notes: Bristol sound-system lineage applied to pop. The research pairs 67–97 with a **half-time** feel, the backbeat on 3 and 16th hats, so `halfTime` is true and the snare is `halftime_3`. Three drum deltas are quoted: "heavy kick on 1 and the '&' of 3" (a loud accent tier on a sparse kick), "snare/clap on 3" with "a soft rim ghost" at a real probability, and "16th hats with a shaker" — the rim and shaker leading the percs. The mix instruction is the fourth fact and it is authored as a gain offset: "the kit is dry and close while everything above it is wide and wet". Harmony moves "once per two bars at most" over "slow modal cycles over a pedal — i–VI–IV or a two-chord vamp; plagal IV–I turns on choruses", so `maxChords` is 3, the harmonic rhythm is weighted to two bars and a vamp, and IV–I is authored as its own family. What separates this model from the All Saints artist entry that shares its records is the counter: his documented signature is "fusing hip-hop/electronic/trip-hop beds with **bombastic choral and flamboyant orchestral forces**", so the countermelody runs a sustained pad and bell echo at a high ratio while the lead stays "conversational and low, sung *under* the arrangement rather than over it" — a low register at a 2–5 density with a real `emptyBarBias`. ⚠ `confidence` is medium because the research rates it medium-high and says the drum detail is inferred. ⚠ The **INFERRED** parameters are every drum probability and `bpm.mode` 74. ⚠ **The bass is `mirror_kick` rather than the held `reese_sustain` the research describes** — *“deep sub with a slow attack and long notes, frequently on a 3rd or 5th rather than the root; almost no movement, which is what makes the pads readable.”* — and that is a limit of the engine rather than a reading of the record. `generators::phrase_spans` re-articulates a held span only when it runs longer than two bars, so over the four-bar clip `reese_sustain` writes at most four notes and cannot reach the 500-bassline floor `engine/tests/bass.rs` holds every model to. `mobb-deep`, `dmx` and `capone-n-noreaga` carry the same substitution for the same reason; `followRootsProb` stays where it was so the line still reads as roots under the chord.
